name: BTF Large Grants Window

funder.name: Bhutan Trust Fund for Environmental Conservation (BTFEC)

administered_by.name: Bhutan Trust Fund for Environmental Conservation (BTFEC)

summary: Bhutan's conservation trust fund gives large grants for projects on biodiversity, human-wildlife coexistence, climate adaptation and development impacts, open to civil society, communities, agencies and others in Bhutan. Projects run up to three years.
reporting: Project partners submit semiannual technical, financial and procurement progress reports, which gate each fund release, and a project completion report at the end.

eligibility.rule: Keep the project duration to 3 years or less

status.quote: The Bhutan Trust Fund for Environmental Conservation (BTF) invites proposals

deadline.quote: no later than 7 July 2026, before 5.00 PM

administered_by.quote: The Bhutan Trust Fund for Environmental Conservation (BTF) invites proposals

applicant_types.quote: Bhutanese agencies, civil society organizations, academic institutions, private sector entities, and individuals with innovative environmental initiatives.

geography.quote: supports environmental conservation, climate resilience, and sustainable development in Bhutan

access.quote: Applicants submit a Concept Note outlining the project rationale, objectives, expected outcomes, and estimated budget

window.quote: no later than 7 July 2026, before 5.00 PM

amount.quote: Up to Nu. 15 million per project (subject to Board approval)

reporting.quote: Project partners are required to submit semmiannual progress report for the first six months along with release request for the next/subsequent six months.

effort.quote: the duly filled project concept note (available for download on website) should be submitted in hard/soft copy to the office of BTF or via email as a single PDF document to Phuntsho Choden at phuntsho@bhutantrustfund.bt, with a copy to Leki Tshewang at leki@bhutantrustfund.bt no later than 7 July 2026

The Environment and Climate Change Services (ECCS) of the BTF Secretariat conducts an initial screening and due diligence assessment to verify eligibility, alignment with BTF priorities, and completeness of the submission.
Eligible Concept Notes are reviewed by the Independent Technical Advisory Panel (ITAP), comprising qualified national experts and practitioners from relevant fields.
Applicants with promising Concept Notes may be invited to present or pitch their project ideas to the ITAP.
Shortlisted applicants prepare a detailed project proposal

after_award.quote: Project partners are required to submit semmiannual progress report for the first six months along with release request for the next/subsequent six months.
